# Live Recovery

<!-- GENERATED FROM data/performance.yaml BY `uv run rig render`. DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE DIRECTLY. -->

Recovery procedures remain evidence-labeled; INTENDED is not VERIFIED.

| Scenario | Severity | Symptom | Actions | Keyboard/mouse | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bad RC-1 loop (`bad-rc1-loop`) | IMPORTANT | Captured phrase is wrong / looping garbage | clear-bad-loop | unknown | INTENDED |

## Bad RC-1 loop

- Prefer RC-1 STOP/UNDO via footswitch (MOSKY Dual Switch candidate)
- Do not rebuild the loop with keyboard if a foot path exists
| Wrong Ableton clip (`wrong-ableton-clip`) | IMPORTANT | Wrong clip launched or recording into wrong slot | — | unknown | INTENDED |

## Wrong Ableton clip

- Stop clip / undo if available
- Return to known Session layout when defined (RIG-038)
| Runaway delay/feedback (`runaway-feedback`) | EMERGENCY | Delay/feedback escalating out of control | runaway-feedback-stop, panic | unknown | INTENDED |

## Runaway delay/feedback

- Kill wet send / mute feedback path
- Prefer panic if mapped and working
| Stuck MIDI note (`stuck-midi-note`) | IMPORTANT | Hanging note / stuck MIDI | all-notes-off | unknown | INTENDED |

## Stuck MIDI note

- Send All Notes Off via intended path when verified (RIG-037)
| KAOSS mistake (`kaoss-mistake`) | IMPORTANT | Unwanted KAOSS capture/effect | kaoss-recover | unknown | INTENDED |

## KAOSS mistake

- Mute/clear KAOSS path; recover sample if needed
| Wrong scene (`wrong-scene`) | IMPORTANT | Wrong Ableton/OBS scene active | return-known-scene | unknown | INTENDED |

## Wrong scene

- Return to known-safe scene when Stream Deck OBS SAFE is configured
| Mute/solo accident (`mute-solo-accident`) | NORMAL | Unexpected mute or solo | mute-solo-recover | unknown | INTENDED |

## Mute/solo accident

- Reset mute/solo on mixer/Ableton as appropriate
| Pedal noise (`pedal-noise`) | NORMAL | Noise from pedals / RE-2 area | pedal-noise-isolate | unknown | INTENDED |

## Pedal noise

- Bypass noisy pedal; change one variable at a time
| Full emergency stop (`full-emergency-stop`) | EMERGENCY | Need to stop everything safely | panic, record-stop | unknown | INTENDED |

## Full emergency stop

- Trigger panic / OBS SAFE when mapped
- Stop recording; mute runaway audio; All Notes Off
